coverage_note: 5G presence records from each operator's published coverage map, as claimed by the operators (not measured RF coverage). Djezzy and Mobilis publish cell-site level points; 18 Djezzy records and 6 Mobilis records have their coordinates withheld because the operator's own wilaya and commune labels contradict the published point. Ooredoo publishes covered communes, so its points are commune-level and marked approximate. Mobilis still labels some communes under their pre-2026 mother wilaya; 40 records are reconciled to the current wilaya only where an exact current or official ONS 2021 French or Arabic commune match and polygon containment agree, with source_wilaya_code preserving the operator value, and 8 more carry a reviewed wilaya correction with the evidence that settled it. Other commune names remain unlinked free text.
